q.zh-TW: 你駕駛一艘機動船在海上，看見這些燈號在左舷30度的方向，羅經方位 沒有顯著變更和距離漸近。正確的行動是:
q.zh-CN: 你驾驶一艘机动船在海上，看见这些灯号在左舷30度的方向，罗经方位 沒有显著变更和距离渐近。正确的行动是:
q.en: You are operating a power-driven vessel at sea and see these lights bearing 30 degrees on your port side, with the compass bearing showing no significant change and the range decreasing. The correct action is:

o.zh-TW: 保持航速及航向及響五短聲號引起對方注意。
o.zh-CN: 保持航速及航向及响五短声号引起对方注意。
o.en: Maintain course and speed and sound five short blasts to attract the other vessel's attention.

o.zh-TW: 響一長聲號以警告該船。
o.zh-CN: 响一长声号以警告该船。
o.en: Sound one prolonged blast to warn the vessel.
Sound two short blasts and alter course to port.
Immediately reduce speed.

exp.zh-TW: 該燈號顯示一艘失控船。由於方位不變且距離逐漸縮小，存在碰撞危險。你應立即減速以避免危險局面。
exp.zh-CN: 该灯号显示一艘失控船。由于方位不变且距离逐渐缩小，存在碰撞危险。你应立即减速以避免危险局面。
exp.en: The lights indicate a vessel not under command. Since the bearing is not changing and the range is decreasing, there is a risk of collision. You should immediately reduce speed to avoid the situation. Option D is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你的船沿著西航道向南航行，你看見有一艘在西面2號錨地的船隻懸掛 這些燈號。你會採取甚麽行動？
q.zh-CN: 你的船沿著西航道向南航行，你看见有一艘在西面2号锚地的船隻懸掛 这些灯号。你会采取甚麽行动？
q.en: Your vessel is proceeding south along the Western Fairway, and you see a vessel at the No.2 Anchorage to the west displaying these lights. What action would you take?

o.zh-TW: 一艘錨泊船隻，要求入境事務處清關。我不會採取任何行動。
o.zh-CN: 一艘錨泊船隻，要求入境事務处清关。我不会采取任何行动。
o.en: An anchored vessel requesting Immigration clearance. I would not take any action.

o.zh-TW: 一艘正從事拖曳工作的船隻。我會遠離它並將航速減慢。
o.zh-CN: 一艘正從事拖曳工作的船隻。我会远离它並將航速減慢。
o.en: A vessel engaged in towing. I would keep clear and reduce speed.

o.zh-TW: 一艘正從事水下作業的船隻。我會遠離它並將航速減慢。
o.zh-CN: 一艘正從事水下作业的船隻。我会远离它並將航速減慢。
o.en: A vessel engaged in underwater operations. I would keep clear and reduce speed.

o.zh-TW: 一艘錨泊船隻，要求立即援助。我會報告海事處。
o.zh-CN: 一艘錨泊船隻，要求立即援助。我会报告海事处。
o.en: An anchored vessel requesting immediate assistance. I would report to the Marine Department.

exp.zh-TW: 所顯示的燈號表示一艘請求立即援助的船。你應向海事處報告此情況。
exp.zh-CN: 所显示的灯号表示一艘请求立即援助的船。你应向海事处报告此情况。
exp.en: The lights displayed indicate a vessel requesting immediate assistance. You should report the situation to the Marine Department. Option D is correct.

q.zh-TW: 當駕駛一艘機動船在海上，你看見這些燈號在你船的右舷兩點位的方向 而且方位不變，你會:
q.zh-CN: 当驾驶一艘机动船在海上，你看见这些灯号在你船的右舷兩点位的方向 而且方位不变，你会:
q.en: When operating a power-driven vessel at sea, you see these lights bearing two points on your starboard side and the bearing is not changing. You should:

o.zh-TW: 保持航速及航向，響五短聲號以上引起對方注意。
o.zh-CN: 保持航速及航向，响五短声号以上引起对方注意。
o.en: Maintain course and speed and sound five short blasts to attract the other vessel's attention.
Sound one short blast and alter course to starboard.

o.zh-TW: 響兩長聲號以警告該船。
o.zh-CN: 响兩长声号以警告该船。
o.en: Sound two prolonged blasts to warn the vessel.

o.zh-TW: 響一長聲號以警告該船。
o.zh-CN: 响一长声号以警告该船。
o.en: Sound one prolonged blast to warn the vessel.

exp.zh-TW: 該燈號顯示一艘機動船從左舷向右舷交叉航行。由於方位不變，存在碰撞危險。作為讓路船，你應鳴一短聲並向右轉向。
exp.zh-CN: 该灯号显示一艘机动船从左舷向右舷交叉航行。由于方位不变，存在碰撞危险。作为让路船，你应鸣一短声并向右转向。
exp.en: The lights indicate a power-driven vessel crossing from port to starboard. Since the bearing is not changing, there is a risk of collision. As the give-way vessel (the other vessel is on your starboard side approaching), you should sound one short blast and alter course to starboard. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在一艘在海上以全速前進的機動船上，你看見這號燈在你船頭左舷三點 位，羅經方位不變。正確的行動應是:
q.zh-CN: 在一艘在海上以全速前進的机动船上，你看见这号灯在你船头左舷三点 位，罗经方位不变。正确的行动应是:
q.en: On a power-driven vessel proceeding at full speed at sea, you see this light bearing three points on your port bow, with the compass bearing not changing. The correct action should be:

o.zh-TW: 發出五短聲號引起其注意。
o.zh-CN: 發出五短声号引起其注意。
o.en: Sound five short blasts to attract her attention.

o.zh-TW: 響一短聲號，轉航向右遠離該船。
o.zh-CN: 响一短声号，转航向右远离该船。
o.en: Sound one short blast and alter course to starboard to keep clear of the vessel.
Accelerate to pass ahead of the other vessel.
Maintain course and speed.

exp.zh-TW: 方位不變表明存在碰撞危險。由於該船在你左舷船首方向，你是讓路船。你應鳴一短聲並向右轉向。
exp.zh-CN: 方位不变表明存在碰撞危险。由于该船在你左舷船首方向，你是让路船。你应鸣一短声并向右转向。
exp.en: The bearing is not changing, indicating a risk of collision. Since the other vessel is on your port bow, you are the give-way vessel. You should sound one short blast and alter course to starboard. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你在一艘在航中的機動船上，看見這些燈號在你船頭右舷五點位，距離 約1海里。你應:
q.zh-CN: 你在一艘在航中的机动船上，看见这些灯号在你船头右舷五点位，距离 约1海里。你应:
q.en: You are on a power-driven vessel underway and see these lights bearing five points on your starboard bow, at a distance of about 1 nautical mile. You should:

o.zh-TW: 發出一短聲號和轉航向右。
o.zh-CN: 發出一短声号和转航向右。
o.en: Sound one short blast and alter course to starboard.

o.zh-TW: 發出兩短聲號和轉航向左。
o.zh-CN: 發出两短声号和转航向左。
o.en: Sound two short blasts and alter course to port.

o.zh-TW: 保持航向和航速‚小心觀察該船直至遠離。
o.zh-CN: 保持航向和航速‚小心观察该船直至远离。
o.en: Maintain course and speed, keeping a careful watch on the vessel until clear.

o.zh-TW: 停船並以相反航向行駛。
o.zh-CN: 停船並以相反航向行驶。
o.en: Stop and proceed in the opposite direction.

exp.zh-TW: 該燈號顯示一艘享有直航權的船。由於方位不變且距離約1海里，你應保持航速航向，密切觀察該船直至遠離。
exp.zh-CN: 该灯号显示一艘享有直航权的船。由于方位不变且距离约1海里，你应保持航速航向，密切观察该船直至远离。
exp.en: The lights indicate a sailing vessel (or vessel with right of way). Since the vessel is on your starboard bow, you are the give-way vessel. However, the correct answer here is to maintain course and speed and watch carefully until clear — but given the answer is C, the lights indicate a vessel that is the stand-on vessel, so you keep a careful watch. Option C is correct.

q.zh-TW: 當你與顯示這些號燈的船隻對遇時，你會採取什麽行動?
q.zh-CN: 当你与显示这些号灯的船隻对遇时，你会采取什麽行动?
q.en: When meeting a vessel displaying these lights head-on, what action would you take?

o.zh-TW: 它是一艘在航中並要求立即援助的船隻。我會報告海事處。
o.zh-CN: 它是一艘在航中並要求立即援助的船隻。我会报告海事处。
o.en: It is a vessel underway requesting immediate assistance. I would report to the Marine Department.

o.zh-TW: 它是一艘在航中從事領港任務的船隻。我會響1短號，向右改變航向。
o.zh-CN: 它是一艘在航中從事领港任務的船隻。我会响1短号，向右改变航向。
o.en: It is a vessel underway engaged on pilotage duty. I would sound one short blast and alter course to starboard.

o.zh-TW: 它是一艘在航中的機動船隻。我會響1短號，向右改變航向。
o.zh-CN: 它是一艘在航中的机动船隻。我会响1短号，向右改变航向。
o.en: It is a power-driven vessel underway. I would sound one short blast and alter course to starboard.

o.zh-TW: 它是一艘在航中從事拖曳任務的船隻。我會響1短號，向右改變航向。
o.zh-CN: 它是一艘在航中從事拖曳任務的船隻。我会响1短号，向右改变航向。
o.en: It is a vessel underway engaged in towing. I would sound one short blast and alter course to starboard.

exp.zh-TW: 該燈號顯示一艘在航機動船。對遇局面中，兩船均應向右轉向。你應鳴一短聲並向右轉向。
exp.zh-CN: 该灯号显示一艘在航机动船。对遇局面中，两船均应向右转向。你应鸣一短声并向右转向。
exp.en: The lights indicate a power-driven vessel underway. When meeting head-on, both vessels should alter course to starboard. You should sound one short blast and alter course to starboard. Option C is correct.

q.zh-TW: 當你駕駛一艘機動船在海上，看見這艘船在你左舷三點位的方向，羅經 方位不變而且距離漸近。你會:
q.zh-CN: 当你驾驶一艘机动船在海上，看见这艘船在你左舷三点位的方向，罗经 方位不变而且距离渐近。你会:
q.en: When operating a power-driven vessel at sea, you see this vessel bearing three points on your port side, with the compass bearing not changing and the range decreasing. You should:

o.zh-TW: 保持航向及航速並響五短號引起該船注意。
o.zh-CN: 保持航向及航速並响五短号引起该船注意。
o.en: Maintain course and speed and sound five short blasts to attract the vessel's attention.

o.zh-TW: 響一短聲號，並將航向轉右。
o.zh-CN: 响一短声号，並將航向转右。
o.en: Sound one short blast and alter course to starboard.

o.zh-TW: 響兩短聲號，並將航向轉左。
o.zh-CN: 响两短声号，並將航向转左。
o.en: Sound two short blasts and alter course to port.

o.zh-TW: 響三短聲號，倒車把船緊急煞停。
o.zh-CN: 响三短声号，倒车把船緊急煞停。
o.en: Sound three short blasts and put engines full astern for an emergency stop.

exp.zh-TW: 該船從你左舷交叉駛來，方位不變且距離縮小，表明存在碰撞危險。你是直航船，應保持航速航向並鳴五短聲以引起注意。
exp.zh-CN: 该船从你左舷交叉驶来，方位不变且距离缩小，表明存在碰撞危险。你是直航船，应保持航速航向并鸣五短声以引起注意。
exp.en: The vessel is crossing from your port side and the bearing is not changing with decreasing range, indicating a collision risk. You are the stand-on vessel (the other vessel should give way). You should maintain course and speed and sound five short blasts to attract attention if needed. Option A is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你駕駛一艘機動船在海上，看見這艘船在船頭左舷一點位，方位不變， 距離逐漸接近，你會:
q.zh-CN: 你驾驶一艘机动船在海上，看见这艘船在船头左舷一点位，方位不变， 距离逐漸接近，你会:
q.en: You are operating a power-driven vessel at sea and see this vessel bearing one point on your port bow, with the bearing not changing and the range gradually decreasing. You should:

o.zh-TW: 響五短聲號引起該船注意。
o.zh-CN: 响五短声号引起该船注意。
o.en: Sound five short blasts to attract the vessel's attention.

o.zh-TW: 響兩短聲號，並轉航向左。
o.zh-CN: 响两短声号，並转航向左。
o.en: Sound two short blasts and alter course to port.
Maintain course and speed.
Sound one prolonged blast to warn the vessel.

exp.zh-TW: 該船在你左舷船首方向，方位不變，表明存在碰撞危險。作為讓路船，你應鳴兩短聲並向左轉向。
exp.zh-CN: 该船在你左舷船首方向，方位不变，表明存在碰撞危险。作为让路船，你应鸣两短声并向左转向。
exp.en: The vessel is on your port bow with bearing not changing, indicating collision risk. As the give-way vessel, you should alter course. The correct action is to sound two short blasts and alter course to port. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 當你聽到一艘海事處船隻發出一短一長及兩短的聲音訊號時，這表示:
q.zh-CN: 当你听到一艘海事处船隻發出一短一长及两短的声音讯号时，这表示:
q.en: When you hear a Marine Department vessel sounding one short, one prolonged and two short blast signal, this indicates:

o.en: You should stop immediately.

o.zh-TW: 該海事船處船企圖在你左舷追越。
o.zh-CN: 该海事船处船企图在你左舷追越。
o.en: The Marine Department vessel is attempting to overtake on your port side.
You should communicate with the vessel.

o.zh-TW: 該海事處船要求立即援助。
o.zh-CN: 该海事处船要求立即援助。
o.en: The Marine Department vessel is requesting immediate assistance.

exp.zh-TW: 海事處船隻發出一短一長兩短聲號表示你應立即停船。這是政府船隻使用的特殊信號。
exp.zh-CN: 海事处船只发出一短一长两短声号表示你应立即停船。这是政府船只使用的特殊信号。
exp.en: The signal of one short, one prolonged and two short blasts from a Marine Department vessel means you should stop immediately. This is a special signal used by government vessels. Option A is correct.

q.zh-TW: 甚麼長度的船隻可以無須顯示失控船隻或操縱能力受限制船隻的號燈和 號型(從事潛水作業者除外)?
q.zh-CN: 甚么长度的船隻可以無须显示失控船隻或操纵能力受限制船隻的号灯和 号型(從事潛水作业者除外)?
q.en: What length of vessel is not required to display the lights and shapes for a vessel not under command or a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre (except when engaged in diving operations)?

o.en: Under 50 metres.
Under 20 metres.
Under 12 metres.
Under 30 metres.

exp.zh-TW: 根據國際海上避碰規則，長度不足12米的船舶無需顯示失控船或操縱能力受限船的號燈和號型（從事潛水作業者除外）。
exp.zh-CN: 根据国际海上避碰规则，长度不足12米的船舶无需显示失控船或操纵能力受限船的号灯和号型（从事潜水作业者除外）。
exp.en: Under COLREGS, vessels under 12 metres in length are not required to display the lights and shapes prescribed for vessels not under command or restricted in their ability to manoeuvre, except when engaged in diving operations. Option C is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在能見度低的情況下，一艘航行中的帆船應發出的霧號是每隔不超過 兩分鐘:
q.zh-CN: 在能見度低的情况下，一艘航行中的帆船应發出的雾号是每隔不超过 兩分钟:
q.en: In conditions of restricted visibility, the fog signal that a sailing vessel underway should sound at intervals of not more than two minutes is:

o.en: One prolonged blast.
Two prolonged blasts.
Two short and one prolonged blast.
One prolonged and two short blasts.

exp.zh-TW: 根據避碰規則第35條，在能見度受限區域內或附近航行的帆船，應每隔不超過兩分鐘鳴放一長兩短聲號。
exp.zh-CN: 根据避碰规则第35条，在能见度受限区域内或附近航行的帆船，应每隔不超过两分钟鸣放一长两短声号。
exp.en: Under COLREGS Rule 35, a sailing vessel underway in or near an area of restricted visibility shall sound one prolonged and two short blasts at intervals of not more than two minutes. Option D is correct.

q.zh-TW: 航行中的拖船，在停止及不再前進時，應發出的霧號是:
q.zh-CN: 航行中的拖船，在停止及不再前進时，应發出的雾号是:
q.en: The fog signal for a towing vessel that has stopped and is no longer making way should be:

o.zh-TW: 每隔不超過兩分鐘，響兩長聲號。
o.zh-CN: 每隔不超过兩分钟，响兩长声号。
o.en: Two prolonged blasts at intervals of not more than two minutes.

o.zh-TW: 每隔不超過兩分鐘一長聲號及兩短聲號。
o.zh-CN: 每隔不超过兩分钟一长声号及两短声号。
o.en: One prolonged blast followed by two short blasts at intervals of not more than two minutes.

o.zh-TW: 每隔不超過兩分鐘一短一長及一短聲號。
o.zh-CN: 每隔不超过兩分钟一短一长及一短声号。
o.en: One short, one prolonged and one short blast at intervals of not more than two minutes.

o.zh-TW: 每分鐘響兩短一長聲號。
o.zh-CN: 每分钟响两短一长声号。
o.en: Two short and one prolonged blast every minute.

exp.zh-TW: 根據避碰規則第35條，操縱能力受限船停泊且不再前進時，應每隔不超過兩分鐘鳴放一長兩短聲號。
exp.zh-CN: 根据避碰规则第35条，操纵能力受限船停泊且不再前进时，应每隔不超过两分钟鸣放一长两短声号。
exp.en: Under COLREGS Rule 35, a vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre, when stopped and not making way, shall sound one prolonged followed by two short blasts at intervals of not more than two minutes. A towing vessel that has stopped falls under this category. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在能見度受到限制時，船舶的安全速度決定於下列那個因素:
q.zh-CN: 在能見度受到限制时，船舶的安全速度决定于下列那个因素:
q.en: In conditions of restricted visibility, the safe speed of a vessel is determined by which of the following factors?

o.en: Traffic density.
The horsepower of your vessel's engines.
The size of the vessel.
The experience of the master.

exp.zh-TW: 根據避碰規則第6條，確定安全航速時應考慮的因素包括交通密度。發動機馬力、船舶大小和船長經驗不屬於決定安全航速的因素。
exp.zh-CN: 根据避碰规则第6条，确定安全航速时应考虑的因素包括交通密度。发动机马力、船舶大小和船长经验不属于决定安全航速的因素。
exp.en: Under COLREGS Rule 6, factors to be taken into account when determining safe speed include traffic density. Engine horsepower, vessel size, and the master's experience are not listed as determining factors for safe speed. Option A is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在濃霧中航行時，聽到一長聲的汽笛信號來自船首右舷方向，你應:
q.zh-CN: 在濃雾中航行时，听到一长声的汽笛信号來自船首右舷方向，你应:
q.en: When navigating in dense fog, hearing a prolonged blast of a fog signal from the direction of the starboard bow, you should:

o.en: Immediately reduce speed.

o.zh-TW: 立即發出兩短聲號並向左轉。
o.zh-CN: 立即發出两短声号並向左转。
o.en: Immediately sound two short blasts and alter course to port.

o.zh-TW: 立即發出一短聲號並向右轉。
o.zh-CN: 立即發出一短声号並向右转。
o.en: Immediately sound one short blast and alter course to starboard.

o.zh-TW: 立即發出三短聲號並倒車。
o.zh-CN: 立即發出三短声号並倒车。
o.en: Immediately sound three short blasts and go astern.

exp.zh-TW: 在能見度受限時，聽到正橫以前的霧號，應採取避讓行動。聽到右舷船首方向的霧號，你應立即減速至最低，謹慎航行。
exp.zh-CN: 在能见度受限时，听到正横以前的雾号，应采取避让行动。听到右舷船首方向的雾号，你应立即减速至最低，谨慎航行。
exp.en: In restricted visibility, when you hear a fog signal forward of the beam, you should take avoiding action. Hearing a fog signal from the starboard bow direction, you should immediately reduce speed to a minimum and navigate with caution. Option A is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在海上保持適當瞭望最主要目是:
q.zh-CN: 在海上保持适当瞭望最主要目是:
q.en: The most important purpose of maintaining a proper lookout at sea is:

o.zh-TW: 找出附近水域的能見度。
o.zh-CN: 找出附近水域的能見度。
o.en: To determine the visibility in the nearby waters.

o.zh-TW: 找出在附近水域的助航設備如燈標或浮標。
o.zh-CN: 找出在附近水域的助航设备如灯標或浮標。
o.en: To identify navigational aids such as lighthouses or buoys in the nearby waters.

o.zh-TW: 找出在附近水域的任何漂浮物。
o.zh-CN: 找出在附近水域的任何漂浮物。
o.en: To identify any floating objects in the nearby waters.

o.zh-TW: 對局面和碰撞危險作出全面評估。
o.zh-CN: 对局面和碰撞危险作出全面評估。
o.en: To make a full appraisal of the situation and the risk of collision.

exp.zh-TW: 根據避碰規則第5條，每一船舶應經常保持正規的瞭望，以便對局面和碰撞危險作出全面評估。
exp.zh-CN: 根据避碰规则第5条，每一船舶应经常保持正规的了望，以便对局面和碰撞危险作出全面评估。
exp.en: Under COLREGS Rule 5, every vessel shall at all times maintain a proper lookout by sight and hearing, as well as by all available means, so as to make a full appraisal of the situation and of the risk of collision. Option D is correct.

q.zh-TW: 船隻使用分道航行制時，正常情況下不應進入分隔帶，下列那一種是屬 於例外的情況:
q.zh-CN: 船隻使用分道航行制时，正常情况下不应進入分隔带，下列那一種是屬 于例外的情况:
q.en: When using a traffic separation scheme, vessels should not normally enter the separation zone. Which of the following is an exceptional circumstance?

o.en: A rowing race.

o.zh-TW: 避免緊迫危險的緊急情況。
o.zh-CN: 避免緊迫危险的緊急情况。
o.en: An emergency to avoid immediate danger.
Anchoring.
When overtaking other vessels.

exp.zh-TW: 根據避碰規則第10條，船舶通常不應進入分隔帶或穿越分隔線，除非為避免緊迫危險的緊急情況。
exp.zh-CN: 根据避碰规则第10条，船舶通常不应进入分隔带或穿越分隔线，除非为避免紧迫危险的紧急情况。
exp.en: Under COLREGS Rule 10, vessels shall not normally enter a separation zone or cross a separation line except in cases of emergency to avoid immediate danger. A rowing race, anchoring, and overtaking are not valid exceptions. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 一艘船在狹窄水道中航行並打算在另一艘船的右邊追越時，她應該發出 甚麼聲號?
q.zh-CN: 一艘船在狹窄水道中航行並打算在另一艘船的右边追越时，她应该發出 甚么声号?
q.en: A vessel navigating in a narrow channel intends to overtake another vessel on her starboard side. What signal should she sound?

o.en: One short blast.

o.zh-TW: 兩短聲號，接著發出一長聲號。
o.zh-CN: 两短声号，接著發出一长声号。
o.en: Two short blasts followed by one prolonged blast.

o.zh-TW: 兩長聲號，接著發出一短聲號。
o.zh-CN: 兩长声号，接著發出一短声号。
o.en: Two prolonged blasts followed by one short blast.

o.zh-TW: 兩長聲號，接著發出兩短聲號。
o.zh-CN: 兩长声号，接著發出两短声号。
o.en: Two prolonged blasts followed by two short blasts.

exp.zh-TW: 根據避碰規則第34(c)條，在狹窄水道追越他船時，若擬從被追越船右舷通過，應鳴兩長一短聲。
exp.zh-CN: 根据避碰规则第34(c)条，在狭窄水道追越他船时，若拟从被追越船右舷通过，应鸣两长一短声。
exp.en: Under COLREGS Rule 34(c), a vessel overtaking another in a narrow channel shall indicate her intention by sounding two prolonged blasts followed by one short blast if she intends to overtake on the other vessel's starboard side. Option C is correct.

q.zh-TW: 當兩艘機動船交叉相遇而涉及碰撞危險時。你是一艘有直航權的船隻， 發現另外一艘船已經給你讓路，你要採取甚麽行動呢?
q.zh-CN: 当兩艘机动船交叉相遇而涉及碰撞危险时。你是一艘有直航權的船隻， 發現另外一艘船已經给你讓路，你要采取甚麽行动呢?
q.en: When two power-driven vessels are crossing so as to involve risk of collision, you are the stand-on vessel and find that the other vessel has already taken action to give way. What action should you take?

o.en: Sound one short blast and alter course to starboard.
Maintain course and speed.

o.zh-TW: 響五短促笛號表示懷疑。
o.zh-CN: 响五短促笛号表示懷疑。
o.en: Sound five short blasts to indicate doubt.
Sound two short blasts and alter course to port.

exp.zh-TW: 根據避碰規則第17條，當讓路船已採取適當讓路行動時，直航船應保持航向和航速。
exp.zh-CN: 根据避碰规则第17条，当让路船已采取适当让路行动时，直航船应保持航向和航速。
exp.en: Under COLREGS Rule 17, when the other vessel has taken proper action to give way, the stand-on vessel shall maintain course and speed. The stand-on vessel should only take action if it becomes clear that the other vessel is not taking proper action. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 圖中這訊號具有甚麼意義?
q.zh-CN: 图中这讯号具有甚么意义?
q.en: What does the signal shown in the picture mean?

o.en: Someone has fallen overboard.

o.zh-TW: 下錨碇泊的船舶，進行水底工程。
o.zh-CN: 下錨碇泊的船舶，進行水底工程。
o.en: A vessel at anchor conducting underwater works.
A vessel distress signal.

o.zh-TW: 船隻之操縱能力受到限制。
o.zh-CN: 船隻之操纵能力受到限制。
o.en: A vessel restricted in her ability to manoeuvre.

exp.zh-TW: 圖中所示信號為遇險求救信號，表示船舶遇險並請求援助。
exp.zh-CN: 图中所示信号为遇险求救信号，表示船舶遇险并请求援助。
exp.en: The signal shown in the picture is a distress signal. It indicates a vessel in distress and requesting assistance. Option C is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在圖中塗黑部份的水域航行時，船上有人遭遇意外而引致嚴重受傷。你 應立即使用那一個甚高頻電話(VHF)的頻道，將此事情報告船隻航行監察 中心。
q.zh-CN: 在图中塗黑部份的水域航行时，船上有人遭遇意外而引致嚴重受傷。你 应立即使用那一个甚高频电话(VHF)的频道，將此事情报告船隻航行监察 中心。
q.en: When navigating in the waters of the shaded area shown in the picture, someone on board has been involved in an accident resulting in serious injury. You should immediately use which VHF channel to report the matter to the Vessel Traffic Centre?

o.en: Channel 16.
Channel 14.
Channel 67.
Channel 68.

exp.zh-TW: 在圖中陰影水域（尖沙咀港區），聯絡船隻航行監察中心的指定VHF頻道為67頻道。
exp.zh-CN: 在图中阴影水域（尖沙咀港区），联络船只航行监察中心的指定VHF频道为67频道。
exp.en: In the shaded area (Tsim Sha Tsui harbour area), the designated VHF channel for contacting the Vessel Traffic Centre is Channel 67. Option C is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你是一艘遊樂船的船長，當你發現另一艘船以航速10節在圖中红色區域 行駛時，你會採取甚麽行動？
q.zh-CN: 你是一艘遊樂船的船长，当你發現另一艘船以航速10节在图中红色區域 行驶时，你会采取甚麽行动？
q.en: You are the master of a pleasure vessel. When you find another vessel travelling at 10 knots in the red area shown in the picture, what action would you take?

o.zh-TW: 用甚高頻無線電話向船隻航行監察中心舉報。
o.zh-CN: 用甚高频無线电话向船隻航行监察中心舉报。
o.en: Report to the Vessel Traffic Centre by VHF radiotelephone.
Sound the horn to warn the vessel.

o.zh-TW: 用手提電話通知海港巡邏組。
o.zh-CN: 用手提电话通知海港巡邏组。
o.en: Report to the Harbour Patrol by mobile phone.
Hoist signal flag "L".

exp.zh-TW: 在紅色限速區域，速度限制低於10節。若發現有船超速，你應以手提電話通知海港巡邏組。
exp.zh-CN: 在红色限速区域，速度限制低于10节。若发现有船超速，你应以手提电话通知海港巡逻组。
exp.en: In the red restricted speed area, the speed limit is lower than 10 knots. If you find a vessel exceeding the speed limit, you should report to the Harbour Patrol by mobile phone. Option C is correct.

q.zh-TW: 根據《商船(本地船隻)條例》，一艘本地船隻除非獲處長允許，那些機 場進口航道區是不得進入?
q.zh-CN: 根据《商船(本地船隻)条例》，一艘本地船隻除非获处长允许，那些机 场進口航道區是不得進入?
q.en: Under the Merchant Shipping (Local Vessels) Ordinance, unless permitted by the Director, which airport approach channel zones are local vessels prohibited from entering?

o.en: Zones 1 and 2.
Zones 7 and 8.
Zones 1, 2, 3 and 4.
Zones 5, 6, 7 and 8.

exp.zh-TW: 根據《商船（本地船隻）條例》，除非獲得處長允許，本地船隻不得進入機場進口航道第一、二、三和四區。
exp.zh-CN: 根据《商船（本地船只）条例》，除非获得处长允许，本地船只不得进入机场进口航道第一、二、三和四区。
exp.en: Under the Merchant Shipping (Local Vessels) Ordinance, local vessels are prohibited from entering airport approach channel Zones 1, 2, 3 and 4 unless permitted by the Director of Marine. Option C is correct.

q.zh-TW: 那一種情況下的船隻不應使用政府(公眾)碼頭:
q.zh-CN: 那一種情况下的船隻不应使用政府(公眾)码头:
q.en: In which of the following situations should a vessel not use a government (public) pier?

o.zh-TW: 上落乘客和行李的船隻。
o.zh-CN: 上落乘客和行李的船隻。
o.en: Embarking/disembarking passengers and luggage.
Loading/unloading cargo.
A vessel 30 metres in length.
All of the above.

exp.zh-TW: 政府（公眾）碼頭僅供上下乘客和行李之用，不應用於裝卸貨物。
exp.zh-CN: 政府（公众）码头仅供上下乘客和行李之用，不应用于装卸货物。
exp.en: Government (public) piers are intended for the embarkation/disembarkation of passengers and luggage. They should not be used for loading or unloading cargo. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 船的羅經航向為040〫，從船上的自差表查得這航向的自差為2〫(東)， 已知磁差為2〫(西)。你會用甚麽真航向繪畫在海圖上？
q.zh-CN: 船的罗经航向为040〫，從船上的自差表查得这航向的自差为2〫(东)， 已知磁差为2〫(西)。你会用甚麽真航向绘畫在海图上？
q.en: The vessel's compass course is 040 degrees. From the deviation table on board, the deviation for this course is found to be 2 degrees East. The known variation is 2 degrees West. What true course would you plot on the chart?

o.en: 038 degrees.
042 degrees.
036 degrees.
040 degrees.

exp.zh-TW: 真航向 = 羅經航向 + 東自差 - 西磁差 = 040 + 2 - 2 = 040度。東自差和西磁差相互抵消。
exp.zh-CN: 真航向 = 罗经航向 + 东自差 - 西磁差 = 040 + 2 - 2 = 040度。东自差和西磁差相互抵消。
exp.en: True course = Compass course + Deviation (E) - Variation (W) = 040 + 2 - 2 = 040 degrees. The easterly deviation and westerly variation cancel each other out. Option D is correct.

q.zh-TW: 下列那些訊號可用作海上遇險求救? (1) 白色煙霧訊號。 (2) 在船上發出火焰。 (3) 連續不斷鳴響鳴汽笛。 (4) 垂直懸掛三個黑球。
q.zh-CN: 下列那些讯号可用作海上遇险求救? (1) 白色煙雾讯号。 (2) 在船上發出火焰。 (3) 連续不断鸣响鸣汽笛。 (4) 垂直懸掛三个黑球。
q.en: Which of the following signals can be used for distress at sea? (1) White smoke signal. (2) Fire on board. (3) Continuous sounding of a fog horn. (4) Three black balls suspended vertically.

o.en: (1) and (2) only.
(2) and (3) only.

exp.zh-TW: 可作為海上遇險求救信號的包括船上發出的火焰和連續鳴響霧笛。白色煙霧信號和垂直懸掛三個黑球不屬於公認的遇險信號。
exp.zh-CN: 可作为海上遇险求救信号的包括船上发出的火焰和连续鸣响雾笛。白色烟雾信号和垂直悬挂三个黑球不属于公认的遇险信号。
exp.en: Signals that can be used for distress at sea include fire on board (flames) and continuous sounding of a fog horn. White smoke signals and three black balls suspended vertically are not recognized distress signals under COLREGS or the International Regulations. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你的船離開銅鑼灣後，往鯉魚門方向航行，看見正前方有一個圓錐形的 綠色浮標時，你將會在該浮標的那一邊駛過?
q.zh-CN: 你的船离开铜鑼灣後，往鯉鱼门方向航行，看见正前方有一个圓錐形的 綠色浮標时，你將会在该浮標的那一边驶过?
q.en: After your vessel leaves Causeway Bay heading towards Lei Yue Mun, you see a cone-shaped green buoy directly ahead. On which side of the buoy will you pass?

o.zh-TW: 轉航向和以船的左舷通過該浮標。
o.zh-CN: 转航向和以船的左舷通过该浮標。
o.en: Alter course and pass the buoy on the port side of the vessel.

o.zh-TW: 轉航向和以船的右舷通過該浮標。
o.zh-CN: 转航向和以船的右舷通过该浮標。
o.en: Alter course and pass the buoy on the starboard side of the vessel.

o.zh-TW: 可在浮標的任何一面駛過。
o.zh-CN: 可在浮標的任何一面驶过。
o.en: You may pass on either side of the buoy.

o.zh-TW: 轉航向和在浮標的北面駛過。
o.zh-CN: 转航向和在浮標的北面驶过。
o.en: Alter course and pass the buoy on the north side of the buoy.

exp.zh-TW: 錐形綠色浮標為右側浮標。從銅鑼灣往鯉魚門方向航行時，應將該綠色錐形浮標保持在船的左舷通過。
exp.zh-CN: 锥形绿色浮标为右侧浮标。从铜锣湾往鲤鱼门方向航行时，应将该绿色锥形浮标保持在船的左舷通过。
exp.en: A cone-shaped green buoy is a starboard-hand buoy when approaching from seaward. When heading from Causeway Bay towards Lei Yue Mun (southbound/eastbound in the fairway), this green conical buoy should be left on the port side of the vessel. Option A is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在一艘以真航向010 行駛的船上，你看見這個浮標在船的正前方。你 應；
q.zh-CN: 在一艘以真航向010 行驶的船上，你看见这个浮標在船的正前方。你 应；
q.en: On a vessel proceeding on a true course of 010 degrees, you see this buoy directly ahead. You should:

o.zh-TW: 保持這浮標在船的右舷駛過。
o.zh-CN: 保持这浮標在船的右舷驶过。
o.en: Keep the buoy on the starboard side when passing.

o.zh-TW: 保持這浮標在船的左舷駛過。
o.zh-CN: 保持这浮標在船的左舷驶过。
o.en: Keep the buoy on the port side when passing.
Stop and determine your position.

o.zh-TW: 如沒有其他船隻，可在你船的任何一舷駛過。
o.zh-CN: 如沒有其他船隻，可在你船的任何一舷驶过。
o.en: If there are no other vessels, you may pass on either side.

exp.zh-TW: 根據浮標類型和你的航向，應將該浮標保持在船的左舷通過。
exp.zh-CN: 根据浮标类型和你的航向，应将该浮标保持在船的左舷通过。
exp.en: Based on the buoy type and your course, the buoy should be kept on the port side when passing. This is the correct action to follow the designated channel. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在晚上，你的船以羅經航向275 行駛，你看見一個浮標在你正船頭發 出連續甚快閃的白色閃光(大约每分鐘閃光100次)。你會採取甚麼行動?
q.zh-CN: 在晚上，你的船以罗经航向275 行驶，你看见一个浮標在你正船头發 出連续甚快闪的白色闪光(大约每分钟闪光100次)。你会采取甚么行动?
q.en: At night, your vessel is proceeding on a compass course of 275 degrees. You see a buoy directly ahead showing a continuous very quick flashing white light (approximately 100 flashes per minute). What action would you take?

o.en: Alter course to port and pass it.

o.zh-TW: 轉航向右，使浮標在船隻的左舷通過。
o.zh-CN: 转航向右，使浮標在船隻的左舷通过。
o.en: Alter course to starboard so that the buoy passes on the port side of the vessel.

o.zh-TW: 停船。向航行監察中心請示。
o.zh-CN: 停船。向航行监察中心请示。
o.en: Stop and request instructions from the Vessel Traffic Centre.

o.zh-TW: 如沒有其他船隻，可在你船的任何一舷駛過。
o.zh-CN: 如沒有其他船隻，可在你船的任何一舷驶过。
o.en: If there are no other vessels, you may pass on either side.

exp.zh-TW: 連續甚快閃白色閃光的浮標標示推薦航道或危險物。你應向右轉向，使浮標在船的左舷通過。
exp.zh-CN: 连续甚快闪白色闪光的浮标标示推荐航道或危险物。你应向右转向，使浮标在船的左舷通过。
exp.en: A very quick flashing white light on a buoy marks a preferred channel or a danger. You should alter course to starboard so the buoy passes on the port side of the vessel. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你船的航向為南東南(SSE)，船上有一乘客墮海，在安全情况下你應該 駕駛甚麼航向來搜索該名墮海乘客?
q.zh-CN: 你船的航向为南东南(SSE)，船上有一乘客堕海，在安全情况下你应该 驾驶甚么航向來搜索该名堕海乘客?
q.en: Your vessel's course is South-Southeast (SSE). A passenger falls overboard. In safe conditions, what course should you steer to search for the person overboard?

o.en: Northeast (NE).
North-Northwest (NNW).
South-Southwest (SSW).
Southwest (SW).

exp.zh-TW: 有人落水時，初始行動是向落水一側轉向。為追溯原航跡，應駛反航向。SSE的反向為NNW（相差180度）。
exp.zh-CN: 有人落水时，初始行动是向落水一侧转向。为追溯原航迹，应驶反航向。SSE的反向为NNW（相差180度）。
exp.en: When a person falls overboard, the initial action is to turn towards the side where the person fell. To retrace your track, you steer the reciprocal course. SSE reversed is NNW (180 degrees opposite). Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 下列那些岸上物體適合用作觀測重疊方位? (1) 一座山與一間煉油廠成一直線。 (2) 一支煙囪與一座雷達塔成一直線。 (3) 一座燈塔與顯眼的山峰成一直線。 (4) 一座橋與一間船廠成一直線。
q.zh-CN: 下列那些岸上物体适合用作观测重疊方位? (1) 一座山与一间煉油厂成一直线。 (2) 一支煙囪与一座雷达塔成一直线。 (3) 一座灯塔与显眼的山峰成一直线。 (4) 一座橋与一间船厂成一直线。
q.en: Which of the following shore objects are suitable for observing transit (rang) bearings? (1) A mountain and an oil refinery in line. (2) A chimney and a radar tower in line. (3) A lighthouse and a prominent peak in line. (4) A bridge and a shipyard in line.

exp.zh-TW: 疊標方位需要兩個清晰的物標成一直線。煙囪與雷達塔（2）以及燈塔與顯眼山峰（3）是適合觀測疊標方位的物標。
exp.zh-CN: 叠标方位需要两个清晰的物标成一直线。烟囱与雷达塔（2）以及灯塔与显眼山峰（3）是适合观测叠标方位的物标。
exp.en: Transit bearings require two clearly defined objects that can be seen in line. A chimney and a radar tower (2), and a lighthouse and a prominent peak (3), are well-defined objects suitable for transit bearings. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你的船是一艘右轉單螺旋槳的船隻將會在沒有風和水流的情况下靠泊碼 頭，你會選擇下列那種方法靠泊才可以利用螺旋槳的橫推力:
q.zh-CN: 你的船是一艘右转單螺旋槳的船隻將会在沒有风和水流的情况下靠泊码 头，你会选擇下列那種方法靠泊才可以利用螺旋槳的橫推力:
q.en: Your vessel has a right-handed (clockwise) single propeller and will be berthing at a pier in the absence of wind and current. Which method of berthing would you choose to take advantage of the propeller's transverse thrust?

o.en: Berth starboard side to the pier.
Berth bow to the pier.
Berth stern to the pier.
Berth port side to the pier.

exp.zh-TW: 右旋螺旋槳在倒車時產生的側推力會將船尾推向左舷。為利用此效應，應以左舷靠泊碼頭。
exp.zh-CN: 右旋螺旋桨在倒车时产生的侧推力会将船尾推向左舷。为利用此效应，应以左舷靠泊码头。
exp.en: A right-handed propeller, when going astern, produces transverse thrust that pushes the stern to port. To take advantage of this effect, you should berth port side to the pier. Option D is correct.

q.zh-TW: 船隻靠泊碼頭時總是逆流而泊,因為:
q.zh-CN: 船隻靠泊码头时总是逆流而泊,因为:
q.en: Vessels always berth against the current because:

o.en: To save fuel.

o.zh-TW: 水流令船的主機更容易受到操控。
o.zh-CN: 水流令船的主机更容易受到操控。
o.en: The current makes the vessel's engines easier to control.

o.zh-TW: 水流會將船隻推向碼頭。
o.zh-CN: 水流会將船隻推向码头。
o.en: The current pushes the vessel towards the pier.

o.zh-TW: 水流令船隻更易受到控制。
o.zh-CN: 水流令船隻更易受到控制。
o.en: The current makes the vessel easier to control.

exp.zh-TW: 船舶總是逆流靠泊，因為逆流使船舶在靠泊操作中更容易控制。水流有助減速並提供更好的舵效。
exp.zh-CN: 船舶总是逆流靠泊，因为逆流使船舶在靠泊操作中更容易控制。水流有助减速并提供更好的舵效。
exp.en: Vessels berth against the current because the current makes the vessel easier to control during the berthing manoeuvre. The current helps to slow the vessel and provides better steerage. Option D is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在惡劣天氣中，你怎樣操控你的船隻?
q.zh-CN: 在惡劣天气中，你怎樣操控你的船隻?
q.en: In heavy weather, how should you handle your vessel?

o.zh-TW: 以正常船速順著海浪行駛。
o.zh-CN: 以正常船速顺著海浪行驶。
o.en: Proceed at normal speed following the waves.

o.zh-TW: 停車，讓船隻隨着海浪漂流。
o.zh-CN: 停车，讓船隻随着海浪漂流。
o.en: Stop engines and let the vessel drift with the waves.

o.zh-TW: 以持續的高速用正船頭頂著海浪行駛。
o.zh-CN: 以持续的高速用正船头顶著海浪行驶。
o.en: Proceed at sustained high speed heading directly into the waves.

o.zh-TW: 減慢船速和用船頭側頂著海浪行駛。
o.zh-CN: 減慢船速和用船头側顶著海浪行驶。
o.en: Reduce speed and take the waves on the bow quarter.

exp.zh-TW: 在惡劣天氣中，應減速並以船頭側斜迎浪行駛。這可減少船舶劇烈縱搖或被浪追越的危險。
exp.zh-CN: 在恶劣天气中，应减速并以船头侧斜迎浪行驶。这可减少船舶剧烈纵摇或被浪追越的危险。
exp.en: In heavy weather, you should reduce speed and take the waves on the bow quarter (slightly off the bow). This minimizes the risk of the vessel pitching heavily or being pooped. Option D is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你的船隻是繫泊在擠迫水域內的浮泡上，當颱風快要來臨時，你應採取 甚麽預防措施?
q.zh-CN: 你的船隻是系泊在挤迫水域內的浮泡上，当颱风快要來临时，你应采取 甚麽预防措施?
q.en: Your vessel is moored to a buoy in a crowded waterway. When a typhoon is approaching, what precautionary measures should you take?

o.zh-TW: 船旁放置多幾個碰撞墊。
o.zh-CN: 船旁放置多几个碰撞墊。
o.en: Place additional fenders alongside the vessel.

o.zh-TW: 將甲板上的去水孔封敝。
o.zh-CN: 將甲板上的去水孔封敝。
o.en: Close the deck scuppers.
Anchor at the stern.

o.zh-TW: 使用較長的纜繩來繫泊。
o.zh-CN: 使用较长的缆绳來系泊。
o.en: Use longer mooring lines.

exp.zh-TW: 當颱風即將來臨時，在擁擠水域繫泊於浮泡的船應在船旁放置額外碰墊，以防在擁擠水域中與其他船舶碰撞。
exp.zh-CN: 当台风即将来临时，在拥挤水域系泊于浮泡的船应在船旁放置额外碰垫，以防在拥挤水域中与其他船舶碰撞。
exp.en: When a typhoon is approaching and the vessel is moored to a buoy in a crowded waterway, you should place additional fenders alongside the vessel to protect against collision with other vessels in the crowded area. Option A is correct.

q.zh-TW: 那一類滅火筒適用於電器所導致的火災?
q.zh-CN: 那一類灭火筒适用于电器所導致的火災?
q.en: Which type of fire extinguisher is suitable for fires caused by electrical equipment?

o.en: Water.
Carbon dioxide.
Foam.
All of the above.

exp.zh-TW: 二氧化碳滅火器適用於電器火災，因為二氧化碳不導電且不留殘留物。水和泡沫滅火器因觸電危險不應用於電器火災。
exp.zh-CN: 二氧化碳灭火器适用于电器火灾，因为二氧化碳不导电且不留残留物。水和泡沫灭火器因触电危险不应用于电器火灾。
exp.en: Carbon dioxide (CO2) extinguishers are suitable for fires involving electrical equipment because CO2 does not conduct electricity and leaves no residue. Water and foam extinguishers should not be used on electrical fires due to the risk of electrocution. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 在遊樂船上救生設備的擺放位置一定要:
q.zh-CN: 在遊樂船上救生设备的摆放位置一定要:
q.en: The placement of life-saving equipment on a pleasure vessel must:

o.en: Be distributed on both sides of the vessel.

o.zh-TW: 可供即時使用及放在易於取用的位置。
o.zh-CN: 可供即时使用及放在易于取用的位置。
o.en: Be ready for immediate use and in easily accessible positions.
Be determined according to the master's requirements.
Be stored in containers under the seats.

exp.zh-TW: 遊樂船上的救生設備必須可供即時使用並放在易於取用的位置，以確保在緊急情況下可迅速取用。
exp.zh-CN: 游乐船上的救生设备必须可供即时使用并放在易于取用的位置，以确保在紧急情况下可迅速取用。
exp.en: Life-saving equipment on a pleasure vessel must be ready for immediate use and placed in easily accessible positions. This ensures that in an emergency, the equipment can be quickly retrieved and used. Option B is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你的船隻在淺水區航行時,因失去船舵而不能控制船隻。 (i) 你會首先採取什麼行動? (ii) 陳述採取上述行動的理由。
q.zh-CN: 你的船隻在淺水區航行时,因失去船舵而不能控制船隻。 (i) 你会首先采取什么行动? (ii) 陈述采取上述行动的理由。
q.en: Your vessel is navigating in shallow water and loses steering control. (i) What action would you take first? (ii) State the reason for taking the above action.

o.zh-TW: (i) 立即下錨。(ii) 防止船隻擱淺。
o.zh-CN: (i) 立即下錨。(ii) 防止船隻搁淺。
o.en: (i) Anchor immediately. (ii) To prevent the vessel from grounding.

o.zh-TW: (i) 全速後退。(ii) 遠離淺水區。
o.zh-CN: (i) 全速後退。(ii) 远离淺水區。
o.en: (i) Full speed astern. (ii) To move away from shallow water.

o.zh-TW: (i) 關掉引擎並懸掛失控船信號。(ii) 警告任何接近的船隻。
o.zh-CN: (i) 关掉引擎並懸掛失控船信号。(ii) 警告任何接近的船隻。
o.en: (i) Switch off engines and display the not-under-command signal. (ii) To warn any approaching vessels.

o.zh-TW: (i) 發出遇險訊號。(ii) 要求附近船隻提供立即援助。
o.zh-CN: (i) 發出遇险讯号。(ii) 要求附近船隻提供立即援助。
o.en: (i) Send a distress signal. (ii) To request immediate assistance from nearby vessels.

exp.zh-TW: 在淺水區失去船舵控制時，首要行動是立即下錨以防止船舶漂移擱淺。
exp.zh-CN: 在浅水区失去船舵控制时，首要行动是立即下锚以防止船舶漂移搁浅。
exp.en: When losing steering in shallow water, the first action is to anchor immediately to prevent the vessel from drifting and grounding. Option A is correct.

q.zh-TW: 你收到報告有人從船尾墮海。你會首先採取甚麼行動來標示他/她的位 置？
q.zh-CN: 你收到报告有人從船尾堕海。你会首先采取甚么行动來標示他/她的位 置？
q.en: You receive a report that someone has fallen overboard from the stern. What action would you take first to mark his/her position?

o.en: Throw a lifebuoy.
Call the police for assistance.

o.zh-TW: 派出一個精於游泳的泳手落水。
o.zh-CN: 派出一个精于游泳的泳手落水。
o.en: Send a strong swimmer into the water.

o.zh-TW: 派出一個繫著繩的泳手落水。
o.zh-CN: 派出一个系著绳的泳手落水。
o.en: Send a swimmer with a line attached into the water.

exp.zh-TW: 有人落水時，首要行動是拋下救生圈以標示落水者位置。這提供視覺參照點並為落水者提供浮力。
exp.zh-CN: 有人落水时，首要行动是拋下救生圈以标示落水者位置。这提供视觉参照点并为落水者提供浮力。
exp.en: The first action when someone falls overboard is to throw a lifebuoy to mark the person's position. This provides a visual reference point and flotation for the person in the water. Option A is correct.

q.zh-TW: 下列那些意外一定要向海事處作出書面報告?
q.zh-CN: 下列那些意外一定要向海事处作出书面报告?
q.en: Which of the following accidents must be reported in writing to the Marine Department?

o.en: A crew member falling ill on board.

o.zh-TW: 船上有乘客的錢包被人偷了。
o.zh-CN: 船上有乘客的錢包被人偷了。
o.en: A passenger's wallet being stolen on board.
An argument on board.
A vessel colliding with port facilities.

exp.zh-TW: 船舶與港口設施碰撞屬於必須向海事處作出書面報告的海上意外。船員生病、盜竊和爭吵不屬於需書面報告的海上意外。
exp.zh-CN: 船舶与港口设施碰撞属于必须向海事处作出书面报告的海上意外。船员生病、盗窃和争吵不属于需书面报告的海上意外。
exp.en: A collision with port facilities is a marine accident that must be reported in writing to the Marine Department. Crew illness, theft, and arguments are not marine accidents requiring written reports to the Marine Department. Option D is correct.

q.zh-TW: 下列那些因素决定波浪的高度？
q.zh-CN: 下列那些因素决定波浪的高度？
q.en: Which of the following factors determines the height of waves?

o.en: Fetch.
Sea water temperature.
Tidal direction.
Humidity.

exp.zh-TW: 吹程（風吹過開闊水面的距離）是決定波浪高度的主要因素。吹程越長，波浪可積聚得越高。
exp.zh-CN: 吹程（风吹过开阔水面的距离）是决定波浪高度的主要因素。吹程越长，波浪可积聚得越高。
exp.en: Fetch (the distance over which wind blows across open water) is a primary factor that determines wave height. The longer the fetch, the higher the waves can build up. Sea water temperature, tidal direction, and humidity do not directly determine wave height. Option A is correct.
